messages:
Claire P: Quick sync — proposing a short playbook for phasing in function-calling/structured-response support. want to lock on guardrails + minimal client churn before I open the rollout. :clipboard:
Vik R: ack, can you paste the high-level gates? will scan for any infra blockers. :eyes:
Claire P: high level plan: 1) config flag + compatibility header 2) small canary (1%) to internal apps 3) expanded canary w/ telemetry checks 4) ramp with automated rollback triggers
Samir: suggest we add an explicit fallback policy in the runtime: if response contains unknown schema, fall back to plain text generation and emit event. avoids client exceptions.
Elena G: +1 on fallback. also need SDK behavior: default to "compat mode off" for older clients; new SDKs set header `X-RW-Call-V=2`.
Claire P: exact flag names I propose: `fncall_enable_v2` (global), `fncall_client_compat` (per-tenant opt-in). SDK header `X-RW-FC-V` as Elena said. thoughts?
Vik R: those names are fine. infra note: dedicated pools need a tiny patch to accept the header for routing to v2 kernels. I'll own that patch if no objections.
Samir: telemetry hooks we need: count(fncall_v2_requests), count(fncall_schema_errors), histogram(response_parse_latency). Also tag events with `canary_audience` and `tier`.
Claire P: good list. add a safety net: create a synthetic canary that runs a small suite of prompts every 5m and asserts no >=2% schema error regressions over 15m window. if triggered, auto-disable `fncall_enable_v2` and notify #incidents + pager.
Elena G: QA: i'll prepare a short test matrix for client SDKs (py/js/go) — ensuring: (a) header present works (b) header absent falls back (c) schema mismatch doesn't crash. ETA EOD tomorrow.
Samir: small nit — for the rollback action, runtime should set a sticky header `X-RW-FC-ENABLED=false` in responses so SDKs can immediately short-circuit and surface a uniform message.
Claire P: love that. add to the playbook. also we need an operator runbook snippet (what to check in console):
```
- check synthetic canary results (last 1h)
- check 5xx/4xx in model gateway
- check error tag fncall_schema_errors > baseline
- check latency p95 increase > 150ms
- if triggered, flip `fncall_enable_v2` -> false, then escalate
```
Vik R: deployment flow I'm thinking: 1) config flag behind feature toggle service 2) deploy runtime patch that honors header (no default enable) 3) deploy SDKs that set header for beta clients 4) enable 1% internal canary 5) watch, then expand audiences
Claire P: can we keep the canary audiences orthogonal to traffic tiers? e.g., internal apps + platform tests + a few customer opt-ins. please add a list of candidate tenants.
Samir: adding retention of old model variant is important: route to legacy model if v2 is disabled. we should tag snapshot ids in telemetry to correlate.
Elena G: code-review pings: i'll send PRs for SDK header in py + js, link here when ready. can someone own the feature flag rollout sheet?
Claire P: I'll own the rollout sheet and audience mapping. putting a draft in /docs/rollouts/ and will link.
deploy-bot: Deployment queued: runtime/2026-03-10-fc-header-accept (staging) — started 1759996210
qa-bot: Synthetic check: initial run completed — 0 schema errors, p95 latency +10ms, next run in 5m
Vik R: staging looks ok. once Claire shares audience mapping i'll schedule 1% internal canary tomorrow morning.
Samir: one more: add a small guardrail that caps v2 token budget per tenant for first 24h (to avoid runaway costs). suggest default 200k tokens/day for new canary tenants.
Claire P: added to playbook. thanks everyone. action items: @Vik patch header routing, @Elena SDK PRs, @Samir telemetry/guardrail config, @Claire rollout sheet. i'll open a formal rollout thread when the sheet is ready. :thumbsup:
Elena G: noted, will ping when PRs are up.
Samir: will add telemetry dashboards and pager rules by EOD.
Vik R: starting infra patch review now.
Claire P: closing this async check-in — touch base in the rollout thread tomorrow. thanks! :sparkles:
